sourceText:
Ground Chicken Salad
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, April 8, 2010 - 12:41am

Ingredients




1 pound Ground chicken
2 tablespoons Oil
1 Clove garlic, minced
1/2 cup Yellow onion chopped
1 1/2 teaspoons Seasoned salt
1 teaspoon Paprika
1/4 teaspoon Pepper
1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce
1 small head iceberg lettuce chop
1/2 Avocado, diced
2 Tomatoes, diced
1/2 cup Green onions chopped
 cup Sliced olives
3/4 cup Grated cheddar cheese
3/4 cup Grated jack cheese
1/4 cup Red wine vinegar
3/4 cup Olive oil
1 tablespoon Tomato sauce
1 tablespoon Lemon juice
Clove garlic, minced
1/2 teaspoon Salt
1/4 teaspoon Pepper
1/2 teaspoon Paprika
1/2 teaspoon Sugar

Preparation

1 Saute chicken in oil with garlic, onion, salt, paprika, pepper and worcestershire sauce for about 10 mins. Cool completely. Toss lettuce with avocado, tomatoes, green onions, olives and cheeses. Mix with cooked and cooled chicken. For dressing, whisk together vinegar, oil, tomato sauce, lemon juice, garlic, salt, pepper, paprika and sugar. Pour dressing over salad. Toss. Serve immediately.
